## LQ v2 Intake (v2.0.1)
POST /webhook/lq-v2-intake with header auth.

1. Validate + score in JS (src/ modules, inlined).
2. One RPC call: lq_v2_accept_batch commits contact, event, score, work item and notification intent in one transaction. Repeats of a source_event_id return the original outcome.
3. Respond only after the commit: 202 / 207 / 400 / 409, or 503 if the database answered with an error. If the database is unreachable the run fails and n8n answers 500; nothing was committed either way.

Slack is NOT called here. The dispatcher workflow delivers notifications.
Contract: docs/v2/event-contract.md
